$comment: The vendor feed list. Adding a fifth Statuspage vendor is a line here and no code —
server/src/adapters/vendorstatus/index.test.ts proves it by loading a five-entry list.
'platform' selects the adapter and is never inferred from 'id'.
'url' must be https: this process fetches exactly what this file says and nothing else.
'component' is optional; when present the feed MUST publish it, or the vendor reads
unknown rather than quietly rolling up a shorter list.
Statuspage: use /api/v2/summary.json, never /api/v2/status.json — the latter is a
page-level rollup with no components, incidents or maintenance.
Zendesk: the url is the SSP base; the adapter appends /incidents.json and, only when a
proofpoint (statusio) and m365 (msgraph) are deliberately absent: their adapters are
Milestone 3. index.ts answers for them with an explicit unsupported-platform error, so
adding them here before the adapter exists reads unknown rather than green.
